items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 89:1
items.html: (To the question) For the external ones have a hold only in a place where there is a lack in the lights. Therefore, since the Mochin of SAG do not suffice for the GAR for the small ZON, the external ones have a hold in their Achoraim, and they must be attached back to back, in the secret of their backs to the house. But from the chest of ZA and above, where he has the GAR, the external ones have no hold, and the Achoraim can be revealed. (Item 102).
